name: Crystal Mountains
description: The cirrus communities perch high up on the Crystal Mountains, breathtaking in their austere beauty. Their architecture, a marvel of design with towering structures, balances gracefully on the mountain peaks, embodying the freedom the cirrus cherish. Access to these cities is a feat, typically requiring magical or aerial means due to the treacherous mountain terrain. Since not all cirrus possess wings to fly, many of them rely on winged creatures as mounts, which can be seen constantly patrolling the skies. The seven largest communities are governed each by one of the seven Zephyr Knights Orders. Historically, the Evolutionist Church and the Tanarean Empire have sought to catalog these settlements, but the persistent mists cloak their boundaries, obscuring where one community ends and another begins. For centuries, alchemists and wizards have attempted to explore these mountains to collect unique herbs unavailable anywhere else in Tanares. However, the harsh terrain and the cirrus’ distrust often make it challenging to obtain these rare components. This often leads adventurers and mercenaries to climb the mountains for flowers or leaves that can earn them significant rewards. Due to their inaccessibility and strong defenses, the Tanarean Empire has never threatened these communities. Still, the same cannot be said of Thundraxa. This penumbral dragon has established its lair in the vicinity of Dark Glacier and has been corrupting white dragons in the region to unleash their fury against the communities of the Crystal Mountains. The elder cirrus defends the hypothesis that these attacks are merely a ruse to camouflage an ongoing plan that the creature is executing.
